ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Mars

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Venus retrograde in your relationships sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between relationships and family. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between routine and conversations. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Venus retrograde in your romance sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between romance and money. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between family and your image. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Venus retrograde in your communication sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between money and friendships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Venus retrograde in your self-image sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your image and your career. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Venus retrograde in your friendship sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your career and relationships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Venus retrograde in your horizons sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.
